text:
sam: Tiny midnight challenge: pick ONE song and ONE short story that feel like a single strange mood. I'll start: 'Nightcall' (Kavinsky) + 'A Very Old Man with Enormous Wings' by Gabriel García Márquez. neon + dust.
alexa: Love that pairing, very cinematic. Mine: 'Retrograde' (James Blake) + 'The Lady with the Dog' (Chekhov). slow unravel. :thought_balloon:
ben: Oof good ones. I'll go upbeat-weird: 'Young Folks' (Peter Bjorn and John) + 'The Swimmer' by John Cheever. suburban dream-sad.
rita: quick pick: 'How to Disappear Completely' (Radiohead) + 'The Last Question' by Isaac Asimov. cosmic and quiet.
meme-bot: Bedtime PSA: mixing synthwave with magical realism may cause vivid dreams. :zzz: reactions: :thumbsup: x2
sam: If you like someone elses combo, drop a "+1" and who. Also optional rule: one instrumental swap allowed.
alexa: +1 @sam (Nightcall + Very Old Man)
ben: +1 @alexa (Retrograde + Lady with the Dog)
rita: swap: would take the instrumental version of Retrograde sometimes.
sam: tally: sam 1, alexa 1, ben 1, rita 1 (swap noted). This thread is solid. Can we make a tiny playlist later? 1 track per person?
alexa: yes please, and maybe a shared doc of stories too.
meme-bot: Poll bot is down for naps. :robot_face:
ben: final: keeping Young Folks + The Swimmer in rotation. night everyone. :crescent_moon:
sam: night! thanks for the recs, perfect weird lullaby material.
